verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers a documented, hands-on-verified CLI and an official MCP server that let an agent read/change collections, requests, environments, and teams, which is a strong agentic automation surface — but there is no actual public REST/OpenAPI API (all openapi.json/swagger.json probes 404). missing for 10: a documented public REST/OpenAPI-spec API, independent third-party corroboration of the CLI/MCP-server in production use beyond the hands-on probe.
